text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d a f-a-k-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y b-u-i-l-d and d-r-o-p-p-e-d i-t into the r-e-c-o-r-d s-t-r-e-a-m, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-t-a-t-i-c p-e-r-s-o-n-a f-i-l-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-r-o-s-s r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k.
2) they s-e-n-t a l-o-n-g c-h-a-i-n of t-r-u-s-t m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s to i-s-o-l-a-t-e the t-a-r-g-e-t and b-u-i-l-d a p-r-i-v-a-t-e l-i-n-k, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-i-n-g a m-e-s-s-a-g-e l-o-g a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-s-e-n-t a-u-d-i-t.
3) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-r-u-m-e-n-t-e-d a p-a-y-m-e-n-t p-l-a-y-b-o-o-k that a-g-g-r-e-g-a-t-e-d e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y e-x-t-r-a-c-t i-o-n s-c-e-n-a-r-i-o-s and a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the f-l-o-w c-h-a-r-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-m-o-u-n-t t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
4) they r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d a m-u-l-e n-e-t-w-o-r-k for t-r-a-n-s-i-t routing and p-l-a-n-t-e-d a n-o-t-e s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e for o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a l-i-n-k-a-b-l-e p-a-t-h, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-o-u-r-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
5) the a-c-t-o-r s-e-a-l-e-d the m-a-t-t-e-r and b-l-o-c-k-e-d c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n b-e-t-w-e-e-n t-a-r-g-e-t-s, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-i-n-g a s-e-a-l-e-d c-a-s-e f-i-l-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-p-o-r-t s-u-p-p-r-e-s-s-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
